title: Chapter 1140
text:
"The Underworld dimension has a lot of strong people from the exploration era. Not only the Primordial Ones, but there are also Supers from various races. There are many Calamity Grade Supers, and they're all antiques …"

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

This group of people was not only useful as a combat force, but they were also witnesses of various periods of the exploration era. They were also reliable sources of first-hand information and knew many ancient secrets.

"Aurora can only create life shells for these Hero Spirits when she reaches the Beyond Grade A realm. Speaking of which, the Underworld dimension is a bit like the Indestructible Mecha Empire … Although I can't summon the Underworld now, it shouldn't be a problem to communicate with their souls. I wonder how much of the Underworld Hella has recovered."

Han Xiao still remembered that he had an Underworld dimension mission. When the Underworld was fully recovered, he would receive Onicelu's gratitude and a [Mark of the Underworld], becoming the third authority dog after the two sisters.

"I'll find a time to ask Hella and see if I'm right …"

Now that Hella had gone to the secondary dimensions, communication was not convenient. However, she should be back at the next Beyond Grade A meeting, so Han Xiao planned to ask her then.

It was not long before the next meeting of the development union, so he did not need to go to the secondary dimensions to look for her.

Soul Emperor faked his death, and he suspected that this was Oathkeeper's true identity. He had not decided if he should test him the next time they met.

Beep beep!

This time, Harrison sent a message, saying that Rody had been properly settled.

"Got it."

Han Xiaoxin was quite happy.

My intuition was right. This time, I did have a pleasant surprise when I returned to Blue Star. I discovered the secret of Destiny's Child, obtained a half-transformed sub-body, and even obtained some key information from Aesop.

However, Aesop's prophecy also made him feel pressured. It was as if he could see that a storm was brewing in the future.

The higher the level of contact, the more secrets he knew, the more he could feel the turmoil and chaos hidden under the stable and prosperous surface of the explored universe.

Han Xiao crossed his hands over his nose and pondered.

"I have to find a way to find out how the Red Empire's research on the World Tree Civilization's wormhole coordinates is going …"

…

After spending a few days as a guest on Floating Dragon Island and paying a visit to Bennett, Han Xiao took the fleet and set off again, heading toward the Flickering World.

On the dock, Ames stood at the edge of the track. The exhaust flames spurting out from the spaceship thrusters made her black dress dance in the wind like a rolling black fog. She led the Floating Dragon officers and watched as the Black Star fleet left the spaceport in an orderly formation. She slowly accelerated, turned into streams of light, and disappeared into the depths of space, out of sight.

"He left again."

Ames retracted her gaze and exhaled softly. She lowered her head and looked at the data storage device in her hand. This was a gift from Han Xiao before he left. It stored an Ultimate Esper knowledge.

She turned around and saw that Jenny's face was ashen. She was clutching a tube of medicine in her hand, which was also a gift from Han Xiao.

"Why do you look so pale? What did he give you?" Ames was curious.

"… Nothing!"

Jenny's facial muscles tightened, and she revealed a ferocious smile. She hid the Hair Growth Magic Potion behind her back.

Aesop stroked his beard, smiled, and said, "Black Star gave me a gift as well. I'm starting to like him more and more."

Beside him, eight fist-sized floating weapons danced in the air.

This was a product that Han Xiao had personally created. It was called 'Explorer — Multi-Purpose Life Protection Array'. It had a full set of functions such as combat, defense, enhancement, life support, concealment, healing, hyperdrive, radiation shielding, and harsh environment isolation. It was especially suitable for solo explorers.

With such a set of equipment, it was equivalent to having a guard team, a logistics team, and a galactic vehicle with them. Even an ordinary person would be able to survive in a Grade B environment for a long time. They would also be able to resist a Calamity Grade Super for a short while and have a chance to escape unscathed. As long as it was used properly, this set of equipment was enough to wipe out an ordinary surface civilization. It was not cheap, and the effect was very strong. Han Xiao had given Aesop ten sets.

Ames blinked and suddenly said, "I heard that you privately asked Black Star to protect me?"

Aesop was stunned. He grabbed his beard and said, "Who told you that?"

"Who else could it be?" Ames raised her brows.

"Tsk, Black Star, this guy, doesn't know how to keep it a secret for me …" Aesop had a headache and nodded helplessly. "There is such a thing. I foresee that the era will change drastically. My ability is limited. Only Black Star has the ability …"

Before he finished, Ames interrupted him and said with a slightly heavier tone, "I'm a Beyond Grade A, and I can protect myself. Next time, before you consider for me, discuss it with me first. I don't like others making decisions for me."

"Alright, alright, consider it my wishful thinking." Aesop raised his hands, indicating that he did not want to argue.

Seeing this, Ames nodded. She suddenly paused, smiled, and said softly, "However, I still have to thank you.

"… But thank you anyway. I appreciate your kindness."

She knew that Han Xiao took the initiative to say this because he did not want Aesop's intentions to be unknown.

Furthermore, this matter could only be said by Han Xiao. It was impossible for Aesop to take the initiative to ask Ames for the credit. He was not such a person.

Aesop also understood Han Xiao's intentions. His complaints immediately disappeared, and he felt a little touched. His impression of Han Xiao went up a level.

Heh, Black Star actually considered my relationship with Ames.

As expected of a talent who built such a huge foundation. This guy has life in his eyes.

…

The fleet traveled for ten days and finally entered the Flickering World through a fast military stargate. On this day, the Beyond Grade A Association held a new round of regular meetings.

A group of Mechanics had missed many meetings because they stayed in the sealed Ancient Star Desert to deal with the Intelligent Plague. Only now did Han Xiao and the others return.

Development Union Headquarters, Planet Finn, Council Building.

Han Xiao's remote projection landed outside the venue. He was wearing the Army Commander's black robe with golden edges. His muscular body made the robe look majestic.

There was still some time before the official meeting, so not everyone had arrived. The remote projections gathered in twos and threes outside the venue, chatting casually.

One of the original intentions of the development union was to build a platform for all the Beyond Grade As to facilitate communication. Other than the official meeting, private communication was equally important.

As soon as he appeared, the venue fell silent. Everyone looked over with different gazes, and the atmosphere was a little strange.

At this time, the old dragon Milizaus led some of the dynasty's allies over and shouted loudly.

"Yo, Black Star, you're finally back."

Han Xiao turned around, smiled, and greeted Beyoni, Yin Ying, and the rest of his acquaintances.

After exchanging greetings, Milizaus praised, "What you did in the Ancient Star Desert really impressed me. It's a pity that I'm not a Mechanic and couldn't witness it with my own eyes."

"That's right. It's such a pity that we couldn't participate in such a historic moment." Viru had a regretful expression.

"If I was there, you wouldn't have fought alone. I would've definitely had a part in fighting Manison," Beyoni said.

Lotus Swordsman did not show any mercy and coldly said, "Forget it. If you were there, you would've been the first to die. You would've been a burden just like Kohler."

Kohler: "???"

Why do you have to drag me into this? I didn't even say anything!

"It's just a small matter, not worth mentioning. Keep a low profile, hehehe …" Hearing everyone's praises, Han Xiao waved his hands humbly.

The aftermath of destroying the virus core made many allies see that Black Star's position had risen again, and he had gained more trust from the three Universal Civilizations. Thus, they all came to support him.

This time, Milizaus looked around and said in a low voice, "Everyone thinks that you and Manison have fallen out. The president and the vice president don't see eye to eye, so there will definitely be different paths. The atmosphere in the association is very sensitive right now."

"No wonder everyone looked at me strangely just now." Han Xiao smiled and was not surprised.

"Today is the first time you and Manison have attended a meeting together after falling out, so most people are watching and waiting to see a good show."

Han Xiao shook his head and said, "Don't worry.

The purpose of the development union is to mediate the conflicts between Beyond Grade As. Manison won't openly go against the rules, or else the foundation of the association will be damaged. This is something he can't accept. Thus, he has to put on an act. At most, he'll make things difficult for me verbally, but it's impossible for him to use the association's power to cause trouble. As for me, I don't need to provoke him … "

After all, I've even taken away the foundation of the Mecha Empire. It's not like I'm the one at a disadvantage.

Han Xiaoxin chuckled and did not say the second half of his sentence.

Milizaus did not deny it and slowly said, "Yes, that's for the best. Don't provoke him. In fact, after Manison revealed his intentions, there aren't many people in the association who support him anymore.

His actions this time are too risky, and many people don't agree with it. Once he succeeds, we'll all be implicated by him and be bound by a certain standpoint. Thus, there are many people who are resentful toward Manison.

"On the contrary, there are many Beyond Grade A members who support your actions. Most of them use the development union to form a group, hoping to obtain higher security and more benefits. However, to go against the three Universal Civilizations because of this? That's too unrealistic. Not many people are willing to take such a risk! Thus, you stopped Manison and established a closer relationship with the three Universal Civilizations. Many people are grateful to you, agree with you, and spontaneously stand on your side. "

Hearing this, Han Xiao looked around and exchanged glances with the members around him. He saw the goodwill in many people's eyes.

"Hmm, as expected."

Han Xiao responded. He had already thought through these twists and turns before.

At this moment, a shout filled with anger suddenly sounded from the side.

"Black Star, you're such a bastard!"

Everyone looked over curiously and saw Secret Master walking over with large strides. His face was as dark as the bottom of a pot, and he looked like he was blaming Han Xiao.

"What did I do to you?" Han Xiao was confused.

"You're still playing dumb!" Secret Master was furious. "You attacked my black market forces in the Ancient Star Desert while the Star Field was sealed!"

"I was following orders to prevent the virus from leaking." Han Xiao blinked.

"Guess if I believe you or not!" Secret Master's face was ashen.

After the three Universal Civilizations removed the seal, he realized that his forces in the Ancient Star Desert had been messed up by Han Xiao. He almost vomited blood.

This feeling was like someone had come to his house to cause trouble and even locked the door. As the victim, he only realized it after his house was ransacked. He was so angry that his lungs were about to explode.

"You've really misunderstood me." Han Xiao said confidently. "The three Universal Civilizations wanted me to control the black market channels and prevent the virus from spreading on a large scale. Desperate times call for desperate measures, so I had no choice but to use a thunderous method. Furthermore, now that the Intelligent Plague has been dealt with, I've already left. It was the three Universal Civilizations who tried to continue controlling the black market in the Ancient Star Desert. For the safety of the universe, I took the initiative to take on such an offensive job. Even if I didn't do it, someone else would. Don't you think so? "

"… The thickest thing I've ever seen is your face!"

Secret Master clenched his teeth, full of resentment.

He did not really want to blame Han Xiao. He knew that the three Universal Civilizations would not compromise in the face of a disaster. He could only blame himself for being unlucky. The location of the virus outbreak just had to be the Ancient Star Desert.

Secret Master also realized that ever since he interacted with Black Star, it was as if he had been tainted with bad luck.

I better stay away from Black Star in the future, lest he implicates me when he gets struck by lightning!

Just as everyone was chatting, another remote projection descended. It was Manison, who was in the middle of a storm.

Buzz!

All of a sudden, the entire place fell silent.

Everyone's gazes gathered, shifting between Manison and Han Xiao. Their eyes were filled with all kinds of emotions.

The only thing these gazes had in common was the playfulness and mockery of watching a good show.

Manison turned around, looking straight into Han Xiao's eyes calmly. Their gazes collided in midair.

Manison's face was calm, as if the conflict between the two of them had never happened.

He slowly said, "We meet again, Black Star."

"What a coincidence, Mecha Empire. I thought you would be so ashamed that you would be absent today."

Han Xiao chuckled and teased.

At this moment, he felt like he was more of a villain than Manison.

On the side, Milizaus rubbed the dragon horns on his head in confusion.

… Didn't we agree not to provoke the Mecha Empire? Did you treat my words like farts?

—

Elves eat skewers without caring about their manners, dragons sit in front of the hot pot with a colander, and demons eat cute dumplings …)
